text:
nina: Noticing weird attribution in the console after a wave of fncall schema rejects yesterday. Some accounts show their requests as hitting the fallback route even though validator rejected pre-routing. Sample error we saw:
```json
{"error":"invalid_shape","message":"expected object for 'input', got array","validator":"strict-validate-v7","request_snippet":"[\"a\"]"}
```
Can we discuss how routing/quotas should behave when validation fails early? tagging @omar @sophia

omar: The current infra behavior is: if validation fails before route resolution we default to degen/fallback route for safety. That causes quota counters to increment the fallback bucket, which breaks billing attribution. Not ideal.

sophia: Telemetry side: we frequently lose `route_id` and `account_id` when validators run before routing. We need a single event that includes: `orig_route_hint` (if available), `route_resolution_phase` (pre/post-validate), `validator_version`, and `schema_error_code`. Otherwise dashboards can't reconcile rejects vs billing.

derek: Two policy choices: A) Preserve original route attribution on rejects (emit `preserve_route=true`) even if validation runs early; B) Always attribute to fallback but emit a clear audit event tying to the original API key/account if we can resolve it asynchronously. A is better for accounting, B is simpler for runtime.

nina: If we pick A we must be careful about spoofing: validators could run with unauthenticated input and we might not have reliable account mapping. We need a safety check: only preserve if `auth_header` present or `signed_request` verified.

sophia: Agree. Proposed event fields for preserves: `route_id`, `account_id`, `attribution_mode` = PRESERVE|FALLBACK|ASYNC_RESOLVE, `validator_decision`=REJECT|SOFT_ACCEPT|MEDIATE, and `validation_event_id` for correlating. Also add `sampling.full_payload_pct` for these events so we can debug shapes.

omar: UX-wise: console should expose a "Routing attribution" panel under Request Diagnostics that explains when we preserved attribution vs when we routed to fallback. Also show the validator snippet (redacted) and a link to request full sample if the customer has audit access.

derek: Operationally: if we preserve route attribution, quota system must accept an override flag `attribution_override=true` with auth signature from the router. We must add validation in quota service that only accepts overrides from trusted internal services. I'll open a short infra PR for the override handshake.

billing-bot: Note: Current billing pipelines only read the effective route from the final handler. Adding `attribution_override` requires a small ingest change. Impact on downstream billing analytics: potential reprocessing required for historical corrections.

sophia: For immediate mitigation I'm proposing a 3-step plan: 1) Add telemetry fields and alert if mismatch_rate (requests where validator rejected but route attribution != original_account) > 0.2% for 10m; 2) Implement safe `preserve_route` only when auth header present; 3) Add console note and per-account toggle (default OFF) to allow customers to opt-into preserved attribution for soft-fails/mediations.

nina: Sounds reasonable. Also add a validation enum so error codes are consistent: INVALID_SHAPE, EXTRA_FIELDS, MISSING_REQUIRED, UNPARSEABLE, TYPE_MISMATCH. Dashboards will use that.

omar: Rollout plan: telemetry + alert first, then enable `preserve_route` in canary for 1% traffic in region us-west-2 with strict auth requirement. If stable after 24h, expand to 10% and then global. Add INF-5345 to track.

console-bot: Created rollout ticket INF-5345 and telemetry PR placeholder https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-777

Derek: I'll implement the quota ingest change to accept `attribution_override` from router and add auth checks. Also adding unit tests for invalid override cases. PR: https://git.internal/repo/quota/PR-88

sophia: I'll add the dashboard panels: "fncall: rejects by schema_error_code", "attribution mismatches by region", and "top affected accounts". Also adding sampling knobs to capture full redacted payloads at 2% when attribution is preserved.

nina: Console UX note: when a customer opts in to preserved attribution we should show a banner: "Requests that previously routed to fallback will now be billed to your route if we can validate auth. This may increase consumption on your plan." Must be explicit.

derek: Good call. Also add a playbook entry to roll back preserve-route globally if we detect >0.5% unexpected attribution spikes or billing anomalies.

omar: ops-oncall should watch for alerts after canary. I'll coordinate with oncall.

sophia: Opening telemetry PR now: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-778 (adds fields, alert rule, dashboard rows)

nina: Thanks all. Action items: Derek infra PR, Sophia telemetry PR, Omar rollout canary, Nina console banner copy. Track in INF-5345. Closing thread and moving discussion to the ticket. :thumbsup:
